about: THE GAZETTEER OF 793-1066 - every place of the game's world that Wikidata knows to have been there some time between 750 and 1066 (longitude -11 to 33, latitude 43 to 69), for the map, the writers and the curators. name: today's name (English where there is one); name_local: the name in the land's own tongue; lat, lon: degrees; x, z: metres in the game's world frame (Lambert conformal, parallels 45N and 65N, centred 56N 5E; x east, z north); kind: emporium = an emporium or trading place; longphort = a longphort, or a Norse town of Ireland; ring_fort = a ring fortress; burh = an Anglo-Saxon burh; palace = a royal palace, Pfalz, royal vill or king's farm; thing = a thing site; mint = a mint; monastic_town = a monastic town of Ireland; cathedral = a cathedral; bishopric = a bishop's seat (the bishopric); monastery = a monastery or abbey; stronghold = a Slavic or Baltic stronghold; ship_find = a ship find; battle = a battle or siege; roman_town = a Roman town still lived in; town = a town, city or village known before 1067; fort = a fort, castle or rampart; church = a church; site = an archaeological site or other remains of the time; settlement = an English vill of Domesday (1066-86); from, to: the years it is known from and to (0 = not known; a year below 0 is BC; a date known only to the century is that century's first year); tier: 1 = one of the 50 ports of ports_793.json (its id is the port's id), 2 = a place a merchant would know by name, 3 = the rest; source: where the record comes from and how it was found; country: today's country (ISO code), for sorting; also: what else the place is. stones: rune stones, picture stones and runic inscriptions, a light layer of their own, same fields. Made by Bake/gazetteer/make_gazetteer.py: do not edit by hand, put changes in Design/content/gazetteer/curated.json (see the README there).
